description: This file defines the 'DeviceListFragment' class, a subclass of ListFragment, which manages and displays a list of nearby Wi-Fi P2P (Wi-Fi Direct) devices. It includes methods for updating the device list, handling user interactions such as selecting a device, and UI updates for individual device details. It also contains an inner adapter class for rendering device items and utility methods for device status descriptions.

classes.name: DeviceListFragment
classes.description: A fragment displaying a list of available Wi-Fi Direct (P2P) peers and managing UI interactions related to device discovery.

classes.name: WiFiPeerListAdapter
classes.description: An internal ArrayAdapter subclass that renders Wi-Fi P2P device items within the list view.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Initializes the list adapter with current peers after activity creation.

methods.name: getDevice
methods.description: Returns the current device associated with the fragment.

methods.name: getDeviceStatus
methods.description: Converts device status integer codes into human-readable strings.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles user tapping on a device item, prompting the parent activity to show device details.

methods.name: updateThisDevice
methods.description: Updates the UI to reflect the current device's name and status.

methods.name: onPeersAvailable
methods.description: Callback invoked when new peer list is available; updates the display accordingly.

methods.name: clearPeers
methods.description: Clears the current list of peers and updates the list view.

methods.name: onInitiateDiscovery
methods.description: Starts peer discovery process, showing a progress dialog.
